column1: # Castlevania: Belmont's Curse (Switch, update 1.1.0 = v65536). Plays on the Mac; reported working on an iPhone.
# Unity 2022.3.62f2 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 19.3.16, NVN. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk
# NPDM: 16 MB of system resource, virtual address memory; the game never sets a heap. The layout of the other Unity 2022.3 profiles: a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region.
# The 1 GB pool keeps StandardAllocator's region at 0.94 GB; Unity's own regions then peak at alias +3.51 GB (README.md#memory).
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0
